hands.view: radial oblique with partial palm, horizontal pen held in air

thumb.trace: The radial thumb crosses leftward from the broad near thenar mass through a single main bend to the broad nail pad pressing the horizontal pen near its center.

index.trace: The upper long-finger ray arches left from the distal hand through two visible bend regions and terminates in a separate pad on top of the pen, above-left of the thumb tip.

middle.trace: The next ray is visible beneath the index near its base, passes through the local pen/thumb overlap and reappears directly below the pen as the uppermost lower nail-bearing pad. Exposed side contours distinguish that return path from the index.

ring.trace: The next lower curled ray follows a separate palmar base under the thumb to a bent forward-returning chain and the central lower nail-bearing fingertip.

little.trace: The outer ulnar ray follows the lowest palm edge through a smaller curl and ends in the lowest short nail-bearing fingertip, clearly separate from the ring.

hands.count_observation: Five separate digit chains are visible or traceable: thumb and index above/against the pen plus middle, ring and little below. The three lower nails belong to separate curved rays rather than extra tips on a branch.
hands.length_observation: The index is less tightly flexed and therefore projects farther left than the three curled fingers. Tracing curved paths, the middle/ring retain substantial segments and the little is visibly shorter and smaller. The foreground thumb is broader due to radial view but has plausible two-section length; no grossly elongated phalanx or unexplained stub is visible.
hands.joint_observation: The thumb arises from the radial thenar mass, with four ordered long-finger bases. Visible bends and terminal nails remain continuous; the thin pen and short thumb overlap do not create a branched or detached fingertip. Entire hand, wrist and a short forearm fit, with only the proximal forearm ending at image-right.

sequence.observation: One actual panel and one hand were inspected. No temporal sequence is supplied, so there is no observed inter-panel side swap or length change; this does not certify an unshown movement. Within-frame uncertainties, if present, are recorded in the hand checks.

limitations: Actual full-resolution image and enlarged digit/contact details inspected. Qualitative visual anatomy only: hidden bones, exact finger lengths and physical feasibility are not measured. Action fidelity is assessed separately against the catalog props and the visible key pose; a static pose does not validate full motion, contact timing or task success.

action_fidelity.observation: 目录目标为细长物水平搬运，道具为笔。原图单手夹持细长笔杆，笔身轴线近水平并离开支撑面，拇指与上侧手指形成明确夹持，符合水平搬运中的持物姿态。单幅静态图无法验证实际位移轨迹、速度或全过程水平误差。
